title: Ordered fallback rail and probing safeguard (hotpatch)
author: Marisa Chen
release_notes: Hotpatch: introduce ordered fallback rail to reduce cross-tenant thrash during regional egress spikes; add probe gating to avoid false positive failovers. Backported to main as emergency fix.
description: Context: During a regional egress surge we observed repeated failover churn where parallel fallback paths triggered contention and caused SLO regressions for steady tenants. This hotpatch introduces an ordered fallback rail to serialize fallback decisions at per-tenant granularity and a probing safeguard that gates regional failover triggers while KV-sync and ephemeral drains are in-flight. Motivation: reduce oscillation and prevent unnecessary regional evacuation during short-lived pressure spikes, improving SLO stability and reducing cold-cache retries. Changes and rationale: 1) ordered fallback rail: a lightweight in-memory per-tenant rail that enqueues fallback transitions and enforces a max-concurrent-fallback of 1 per tenant, with a time-window hysteresis to avoid rapid reopens; 2) probe gating: region health probes now require two sustained probe failures (configurable) and will be suppressed while KV pressure metrics (kv_cache_pressure, inflight_prefetch) exceed thresholds; 3) pretrim pass for queued requests: best-effort trimming of low-priority queued requests to keep admission queues bounded during failover; 4) telemetry: emit fallback_rail.event and probe_gate.reason with tags for tenant, region, and prior_state to aid post-incident analysis; 5) runbook/docs: emergency rollback steps and a checklist for operators added. Checklist: - [x] implement ordered rail with hysteresis - [x] add probe gating condition and metrics hooks - [x] unit + integration tests for rail semantics - [x] e2e scenario reproducer and mitigation test - [x] add runbook fragment and rollout notes Commits summary: feat(fallback): add ordered fallback rail and per-tenant queueing; fix(probe): gate region probe during kv pressure; perf(queue): pretrim low-priority requests; telemetry: baseline fallback_rail and probe_gate events; docs: runbook and rollout. Files changed high-level: runtime/fallback/ordered_rail.go (core logic and tests), runtime/metrics/pressure.go (pressure thresholds), probes/region_probe.go (gating logic), telemetry/events.go (new event types), helm/templates/evacuation-config.yaml (runtime toggles), docs/runbooks/regional-fallback.md (operator steps), test/e2e/fallback_rail_surge_test.go (scenario). Review conversation (high level): "Luca Moretti: Could the ordered rail become a hotspot for high-throughput tenants?" Author reply: "Marisa: We bound rail cost—rail state is sharded by tenant hash and only holds a tiny token + timestamp; benchmarking shows <1% p95 CPU on synthetic 100k tps tenant." "Ayesha Rahman: Probe gating thresholds look conservative; can we expose them as feature flags?" Author: "Added helm toggles and runtime feature flags; defaults mimic previous behavior until rollout." "Benji Ortiz: Add a safety valve to bypass rail during manual evacuations." Author: "Added admin override endpoint and documented the rollback steps in the runbook." CI details: Build: pass; Unit tests: pass; Integration: pass; E2E: failed once due to unrelated flaky network simulator, rerun passed; Lint: pass with one style warning fixed in follow-up commit. Metrics and canary plan: Roll out to 10% of capacity in region-us-east-1 for 1 hour, monitor p50/p95 latency, fallback.count, slo.error_budget_spent, kv_cache_pressure. If fallback.count does not drop and error budget continues to burn, rollback immediately. Merge: squashed and merged by Ayesha Rahman (squash), merge commit 0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d. Backport/hotfix: cherry-picked to release/2026-02-13 as part of the emergency patch. Notes for operators: To disable the ordered-rail set helm value fallback.orderedRail.enabled=false and restart control-plane pods; to force a region failover during maintenance use admin override endpoint /admin/fallback/force with tenant-scoped flag. Related: ENG-6543 tracks a follow-up to evaluate per-tenant sharding with cross-region stickiness and SRE-112 is the postmortem action item to tune probe thresholds.
